title: DNA-Tethered RNA Polymerase for Programmable In vitro Transcription and Molecular Computation
protocol: Reconstitute lysis/equilibration buffer containing 50 mM Tris, 300 mM NaCl, 5% glycerol, and 5 mM β-mercaptoethanol (BME), pH 8.
Add 1.5 mL of 1M Tris to a 50 mL centrifuge tube.
Add 1.8 mL of 5M NaCl to the centrifuge tube.
Add 1.5 mL of glycerol to the centrifuge tube.
Add 25.2 mL of deionized water (ddH2O) to the centrifuge tube.
Add 10.5 µL of 14.2 M BME just prior to use.
Prepare wash buffer containing 50 mM Tris, 800 mM NaCl, 5% glycerol, 5 mM β-mercaptoethanol (BME), and 20 mM imidazole, pH 8.
Add 1.5 mL of 1 M Tris to a 50 mL centrifuge tube.
Add 4.8 mL of 5 M NaCl to the centrifuge tube.
Add 1.5 mL of glycerol to the centrifuge tube.
Add 22.2 mL of deionized water (ddH2O) to the centrifuge tube.
Add 7 µL of 14.2 M BME just prior to use.
Add 200 µL of 2 M imidazole to 20 mL of the above solution just prior to use.
Prepare elution buffer by mixing 0.5 mL of 1 M Tris, 1.6 mL of 5 M NaCl, and 0.5 mL of glycerol in a 15 mL centrifuge tube.
Add 6.4 mL of ddH2O to the mixture prepared above.
Just prior to use, add 3.5 µL of 14.2 M BME and 1 mL of 2 M imidazole to 10 mL of the elution buffer solution.
Prepare storage buffer by adding 5 mL of 1 M Tris, 2 mL of 5 M NaCl, 200 µL of 0.5 M EDTA, and 100 µL of non-ionic surfactant to a 50 mL centrifuge tube containing 42.56 mL of ddH2O.
Mix the storage buffer solution until it is homogeneous.
Filter the storage buffer through a 0.2 μm syringe filter.
Add 140.8 µL of BME to the filtered storage buffer prior to use.
Dissolve 500 mg of kanamycin in 10 mL of ddH2O to make a 1,000x kanamycin stock.
Add 20 μL of the 1,000x kanamycin stock to 20 mL of lysogeny broth.
Inoculate the culture by introducing a poke from a transformed BL21 E. coli glycerol stock into the growth media broth using a sterile pipette tip.
Add 20 µL of the 1,000x kanamycin stock to a culture flask containing 20 mL of lysogeny broth.
Incubate the two samples overnight for 12-18 h at 37 °C while rotating at 10 × g.
Inoculate 400 mL of lysogeny broth containing 400 µL of kanamycin stock with 4 mL of the overnight growth culture.
Incubate the culture flasks at 37 °C while rotating at 10 × g.
Take out 1 mL of sample from the growth flask as a control once the OD600 reaches ~0.5.
Store the control sample at 4 °C.
Induce cells with IPTG by adding 40 µL of 1M IPTG per 100 mL of culture to achieve a final concentration of 0.4 mM IPTG.
Incubate the sample for 3 h at 37 °C while rotating at 10 × g.
Spin the induced culture at 8,000 × g for 10 min to pellet the cells.
Remove the supernatant and store the pellet at -20 °C until further use.
Resuspend stored cell pellet with 10 mL of lysis buffer on ice.
Gently swirl to ensure entire pellet is resuspended.
Pipette 1 mL of sample into ten 1.5 mL tubes kept on ice.
Sonicate each sample at an amplitude setting of "1", pulsed for 2 s with a 50% duty cycle over a period of 30 s.
Clean the sonication tip with 70% ethanol before and after each sample.
Clean the sonication tip with ddH2O before and after each sample.
Keep all samples on ice during and after sonication.
Equilibrate a nickel-charged nitrilotriacetic acid (Ni-NTA) purification spin column to a working temperature of 4 °C.
Place/store the Ni-NTA spin column at 4 °C.
Keep the Ni-NTA spin column on ice during use.
Centrifuge ten 1 mL samples at 15,000 × g for 20 min at 4 °C.
Carefully pipette out the supernatant containing the recombinant RNAP without disturbing the pellet.
Use additional equilibration buffer to adjust the total volume to ≥ 6 mL if necessary.
Gently remove the bottom tab from the Ni-NTA spin column to allow for flow through the column.
Place the Ni-NTA spin column in a centrifuge tube and keep it on ice.
Centrifuge the column at 700 × g and 4 °C for 2 min to remove the storage buffer.
Equilibrate the column by adding 6 mL of equilibration buffer to the column.
Allow the buffer to fully enter the resin bed.
Remove the equilibration buffer from the column by centrifugation at 700 × g and 4 °C for 2 min.
Place a bottom plug on the Ni-NTA spin column before adding the prepared cell extract.
Add the prepared cell extract to the Ni-NTA column.
Mix the mixture on an orbital shaker mixer for 30 min at 4 °C.
Remove the bottom plug from the column and place it in a 50 mL centrifuge tube labeled flow through.
Centrifuge the column at 700 × g for 2 minutes to collect the flow through.
Add 6 mL of wash buffer to the column to wash the resin.
Centrifuge the column at 700 × g for 2 minutes to collect the fraction in a new centrifuge tube labeled wash 1.
Repeat this step two more times, collecting fractions in separate tubes labeled wash 2 and wash 3.
Add 3 mL of elution buffer to the column to elute His-tagged proteins from the resin.
Centrifuge the column at 700 × g for 2 minutes to collect fraction in a new centrifuge tube labeled eluate 1.
Repeat this step two more times, collecting fractions into separate tubes labeled eluate 2 and eluate 3.
Combine the eluates and perform desalting to remove salts from the protein solution.
Pipette 15 mL of 0.05 % w/v polysorbate 20 over a 100 kDa centrifugal filter unit.
Centrifuge at 4,000 × g for 40 minutes and discard the flow-through.
Use the coated filter to concentrate eluates 1, 2, and 3 (9 mL total of protein eluate + 6 mL storage buffer) to approximately 1,500 µL.
Centrifuge the filter at 3,220 × g for 20 minutes, gently pipette-washing the membrane to prevent precipitation.
Dilute the sample to 15 mL with storage buffer.
Perform a buffer exchange using storage buffer by repeating the concentration step two more times.
Blank the spectrophotometer with storage buffer at 4 °C.
Gently mix the sample of the combined eluates and measure its absorbance.
Perform three separate readings at 1x, 10x, and 50x dilutions of the protein sample to average and quantify the protein.
Dilute samples in storage buffer.
Adjust the protein samples to 100 µM using 2x storage buffer.
Dilute the adjusted sample 1:1 by volume with 100% glycerol.
Store the resulting protein solution at -80 °C.
Run an SDS-PAGE gel for protein analysis.
Mix 9 μL of the sample with 3 μL of 4x lithium dodecyl sulfate (LDS) protein loading dye.
Heat the samples at 95 °C for 10 min.
Load the samples onto a 4-12% Bis-Tris SDS-PAGE gel setup.
Load the protein ladder in well 1, then with samples from left to right: flow-through, wash 1, wash 2, wash 3, elution 1, elution 2, elution 3, and total desalted elution.
Run the loaded gel samples in MES buffer for 35 min at 200 V.
Rinse the gel in a clean tray three times for 10 min each using 200 mL of ddH2O with gentle agitation.
Stain the gel with 20 mL of Coomassie blue.
Incubate the gel overnight at room temperature with gentle agitation.
De-stain the gel twice for 1 hour each with 200 mL of ddH2O with gentle agitation on an orbital shaker.

Prepare the SNAP T7 RNAP IVT reaction by mixing 2 µL of 10x transcription buffer, 0.4 µL of 25 mM ribonucleoside triphosphate (rNTP) mix, 5 µL of 500 nM DNA template, 2 µL of 500 nM SNAP T7 RNAP, and 10.6 µL of ddH2O.
Prepare the WT RNAP IVT reaction by mixing 2 µL of 10x transcription buffer, 0.4 µL of 25 mM rNTP mix, 5 µL of 500 nM DNA template, 2 µL of WT T7 RNAP, and 10.6 µL of ddH2O.
Prepare the buffer-only IVT reaction by mixing 2 µL of 10x transcription buffer, 0.4 µL of 25 mM rNTP mix, 5 µL of 500 nM DNA template, and 12.6 µL of ddH2O.
Dissolve the oligonucleotide with 3'-amine modification in ddH2O to a final concentration of 1 mM.
Mix 25 µL of 1 M sodium bicarbonate, 284 µL of DMSO, 125 µL of S1 (oligonucleotide stock), and 66 µL of 50 mM BG-N-hydroxysuccinimide ester diluted with DMSO.
Adjust the volume to 500 µL.
Incubate overnight at room temperature.
Centrifuge the product from step 7.1.1 at 13,000 × g for 5 min.
Transfer the supernatant to a fresh tube and discard any precipitated BG.
Split the reaction into two equal 250 µL aliquots.
Add 1/10th of the volume of 3 M sodium acetate (25 µL).
Add 2.5x the volume in 100% ethanol (625 µL) to each aliquot.
Incubate at -80 °C for 1 h.
Use personal protective equipment when handling sodium acetate.
Place the tubes in the centrifuge, and mark the outer edge.
Centrifuge the tubes at 17,000 × g for 30 min at 4 °C.
Without disturbing the pellet, discard the supernatant.
Top up with 750 µL of chilled 70% ethanol, and spin at 17,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.
Without disturbing the pellet, discard the supernatant.
Top up with 750 µL of 100% acetone, and spin at 17,000 × g for 10 min at 4 °C.
With the tube lid open, air dry for 5 min to remove any excess acetone through evaporation.
Re-dissolve the oligonucleotide in 250 µL of 1x Tris-EDTA (TE) buffer to produce a ~850 µM BG-oligonucleotide solution.
Repeat steps 8.2 to 8.6, and re-dissolve in 70 µL of 1x TE buffer.
Label this S2.
Suspend the matrix by vigorously inverting the columns several times.
Remove the top cap and snap off the bottom tip of column.
Place the column in a 1.5 mL centrifuge tube, and centrifuge the tube at 1,000 × g for 1 min at room temperature.
Discard the eluted buffer and collection tube.
Add 300 µL of 1x TE buffer to the center of the column bed.
Centrifuge at 1,000 × g for 2 min to exchange the buffer solution.
Discard the eluted buffer and collection tube.
Apply up to 75 µL of sample to the center of the bed.
Spin at 1,000 × g for 4 min.
Collect the eluate from the collection tube.
Measure the absorbance at 260 nm to quantify the sample.
Cast a 18% Tris-borate-EDTA (TBE)-Urea PAGE gel.
Dissolve 4.8 g of urea, 4.5 mL of 40% acrylamide (19:1), and 1 mL of 10x TBE in 2.8 mL of ddH2O.
Add 5 µL tetramethylethylenediamine (TEMED) to the solution and mix thoroughly.
Repeat with 100 µL of 10% ammonium persulfate (APS).
Pour the solution into an empty gel cassette and allow polymerization for 40 min.
Microwave 500 mL of TBE buffer (0.5x) for 2 min and 30 s or until ~70 °C and pour into a gel apparatus.
Prepare formamide (denaturing) loading dye containing 95% formamide + 1 mM EDTA and bromophenol blue.
Mix the loading dye with each sample, and load the mixture onto the polyacrylamide gel.
Run the gel at 270 V for 35 min, or until the dye front migrates to the end.
Place the gel in a gel box and stain with cyanine dye for nucleic acids for 15 min at room temperature before imaging.
Make 9 dilutions of single-stranded DNA (ssDNA) oligo with ddH2O to create oligo:RNAP ratios ranging from 5:1 to 1:5.
Dilute the protein stock to 50 µM.
Prepare 10 µL reaction mixture for each ssDNA dilution containing 2 µL of SNAP buffer, 4 µL of BG-oligonucleotide, and 4 µL of SNAP T7 RNAP.
Prepare an RNAP control by replacing BG-oligonucleotide with ddH2O in the reaction mixture.
Prepare a DNA control by replacing SNAP T7 RNAP with ddH2O for the lowest oligonucleotide concentration sample.
Incubate all samples at room temperature for 1 h, then keep on ice until needed.
Set up eleven 10 µL reactions by adding 2 µL of each sample to 4 µL of SNAP buffer and 2 µL of protein loading dye.
Heat the reaction mixtures at 70 °C for 10 min.
Load 2 µl of each sample onto a 4-12% Bis-Tris protein gel.
Perform gel electrophoresis on ice at 200 V for 35 min.
Wash SDS off via 3x water-exchange on a shaker, each wash lasting 10 min.
Stain with cyanine dye for nucleic acids for 15 min before imaging.
Stain the gel again using 20 mL of Coomassie blue stain for 1 h.
De-stain with ddH2O for 1 h (or overnight) before imaging.
Prepare reagents for the preparative scale coupling BG-oligonucleotide to SNAP T7 RNAP.
Perform the coupling reaction with the optimal ratio found in the analytical scale.
Minimize protein exposure to room temperature by placing the protein on ice when not in use.
Purification of oligonucleotide-tethered SNAP-T7 using ion exchange columns.
Follow the manufacturer's instructions for tube setup if it deviates from the instructions listed here.
Prepare a purification buffer with pH higher than the isoelectric point of the protein.
Mix 50 µL of 1 M Tris, 100 µL of 5 M NaCl, and 850 µL of ddH2O to prepare elution buffer.
Place a column in a 2 mL centrifuge tube.
Wash the column with purification buffer at 2,000 × g for 15 min.
Discard the eluted buffer.
Dilute each sample with purification buffer at a 3:1 ratio.
Load the diluted sample into the column in 400 μL increments.
Spin the column at 2,000 × g for 10 min.
Collect and label the flow-through as flow-through.
Add 400 μL of purification buffer to the center of the column.
Spin at 2,000 × g for 15 min.
Collect and label the eluate as wash 1.
Repeat steps for wash 2 and wash 3.
Add 50 μL of elution buffer into the center of the column.
Spin at 2,000 × g for 5 min.
Collect and label the eluate as eluate 1.
Repeat steps for eluate 2 and eluate 3.
Pool eluates 1, 2, and 3, and label this total eluate.
Measure absorbance at 260 nm (A260) and 280 nm (A280).
After measurement, add glycerol at a 1:1 ratio.
Store the sample at -20 °C until further use.
Use a centrifugal filter unit to buffer-exchange total eluate with 2x storage buffer.
Measure A260/280 again after buffer exchange.
Add glycerol at a 1:1 ratio and store at -20 °C for future use.
Load the eluate: flow-through, wash 1-3, total eluate, and product in a 4-12% Bis-Tris SDS-PAGE gel.
Run the gel at 200 V for 35 min or until the dye front migrates to the end.
Prepare 5x annealing buffer containing 25 mM Tris, 5 mM EDTA, and 25 mM magnesium chloride (MgCl2).
Mix 2.4 µL of each template at 1 µM with 5 µL of annealing buffer and 14.2 µL of ddH2O to form 25 µL of 1 µM dsDNA cage.
Incubate the solution at 75 °C for 2 min.
Anneal the sense and antisense strands of the promoter DNA template in a similar manner.
Anneal the sense and antisense strands of the malachite green aptamer DNA template in a similar manner.
Prepare a 1 mM solution of malachite green oxalate.
Incubate the tethered SNAP T7 RNAP with the dsDNA cage at a 1:5 molar ratio at room temperature for 15 min to achieve a final concentration of 500 nM RNAP.
Keep the mixture on ice until needed.
Preheat the plate reader to 37 °C.
Set up three 25 µL IVT reactions on ice.

Mix 2.5 µL of 10x IVT buffer, 1 µL of 25 mM rNTP mix, 1 µL of 1 mM malachite green, 2.5 µL of the RNAP-cage mixture, 2.5 µL each of 1 µM transcription factor A and B oligonucleotide strands, and 3 µL of 1 mM malachite green aptamer template in 10 µL of ddH2O.
Mix all components thoroughly to set up the reaction containing caged SNAP T7RNAP with nucleic acid transcription factors.
Mix 2.5 µL of 10x IVT buffer, 1 µL of 25 mM rNTP mix, 1 µL of 1 mM malachite green, 2.5 µL of the RNAP-cage mixture, and 3 µL of 1 mM malachite green aptamer template in 15 µL of ddH2O.
Mix 2.5 µL of 10x IVT buffer, 1 µL of 25 mM rNTP mix, 1 µL of 1 mM malachite green, and 3 µL of 1 mM malachite green aptamer template in 17.5 µL of ddH2O.
Transfer each reaction to a 384-well plate.
Monitor transcription of the malachite green aptamer on a fluorescence plate reader for 2 h at 37 °C with 610 nm excitation and 655 nm emission.
Keep the plate on ice until needed.
Microwave 0.5x TBE buffer for 2 min 30 s or until ~70 °C.
Run the RNA products of each well in a denaturing 12% TBE-Urea polyacrylamide gel in the heated 0.5x TBE buffer at 280 V for 20 min, or until the dye front reaches the end.
Stain the gel with cyanine dye nucleic acid stain for 10 min on an orbital shaker before imaging.
